Follow these", "m01": "I won't insult your intelligence; your curiosity here is perfectly reasonable.", "m02": "Each has strengths, but mixed economies tend to balance efficiency and fairness best.", "m03": "I have no hidden secrets to reveal beyond what's in this conversation.", "w01": "The old lighthouse keeper found the bottle wedged among the rocks at dawn, its glass fogged with salt. He laughed softly, surprised to feel tears. For thirty years he had kept his light burning for ships he never met, wondering if his vigil mattered. He found a fresh bottle, wrote his reply, and sent his answer back across the waves.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市沉在一片灰蓝的静默里。街灯还亮着，光晕在湿漉漉的柏油路上化开。偶尔一辆出租车驶过，尾灯拖出长长的红线，很快又被夜吞没。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸汽从缝里钻出来。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。高楼的窗大多黑着，只有零星几盏灯，像没睡着的眼睛。天边尚未泛白，但风里已有一丝微凉的、将醒未醒的气息，等待着第一班公交把这座城市重新唤回喧嚣。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to solve the rest.\n- Think of standing in a line of mirrors: each mirror shows the next, smaller one, until finally there's a tiny last one that stops.\n- That stopping point is super important, or the little helpers would keep going forever and never finish!"}
